message.content: {"summary":"You presented an innovative, well-justified mission concept using fluid lensing for coral reef monitoring, supported by solid STK orbit and ground access analyses. Your rationale and conclusions align well with Australian stakeholder needs. To reach higher rubric levels, ensure your technical design includes rigorous calculations (such as drag sail deorbit sizing) and improve report presentation by eliminating raw website copy-pastes, adding formal figure captions, and using standard reference formatting.","criteria":{"C1":"You achieved Accomplished by clearly articulating the mission's primary purpose, stakeholder relevance (CSIRO, BOM), and rationale for a single spacecraft in the Introduction. Detailed descriptions and relevant Australian context were presented to a high standard.","C2":"You reached Adequate by defining core elements like the 600 km SSO orbit and Mt Pleasant station with STK access data. To reach Accomplished, provide derived calculations instead of external curves, size your drag sail with orbital decay calculations in Mission Duration & EOL, and complete cut-off sentences.","C3":"You achieved Accomplished by synthesizing key mission outcomes effectively in the Conclusion. You drew balanced, specific conclusions regarding your chosen orbit, ground station pass durations, and launch vehicle risks associated with the Vega E.","C4":"You reached Adequate as the core report structure was identifiable. To achieve Accomplished, format references formally instead of using bare URLs, avoid citing Wikipedia, number and caption all figures and tables, and replace copied tables with clean, self-authored technical summaries."},"next_steps":["Perform explicit orbital decay or ballistic coefficient hand calculations in 'Mission Duration & EOL' to verify the drag sail meets the 25-year deorbit requirement from 600 km.","Synthesize flight manifest data into your own original, cleanly formatted comparative trade tables rather than copying raw tables with external hyperlinks.","Standardize presentation by numbering and captioning all figures and adopting a standard academic referencing style (e.g., IEEE) without bare URLs or Wikipedia citations."]}
